title: Supplementation with a fish protein hydrolysate (Micromesistius poutassou): effects on body weight, body composition, and CCK/GLP-1 secretion

citation.title: Supplementation with a fish protein hydrolysate (Micromesistius poutassou): effects on body weight, body composition, and CCK/GLP-1 secretion

printed_heading.text: ORIGINAL ARTICLE Supplementation with a fish protein hydrolysate (Micromesistius poutassou): effects on body weight, body composition, and CCK/GLP-1 secretion Vincenzo Nobile1 *, Elisa Duclos2 , Angela Michelotti1 , Gioia Bizzaro1 , Massimo Negro3 and Florian Soisson2 1 Farcoderm Srl member of Complife Group, Pavia, Italy; 2 Compagnie des Pêches Saint-Malo Santé, Saint Malo, France; 3 Laboratory of Pharmacobiochemistry, Sports Nutrition and Nutriceuticals, University of Pavia, Pavia, Italy

what_it_measured.text: Supplementation with a fish protein hydrolysate (Micromesistius poutassou): effects on body weight, body composition, and CCK/GLP-1 secretion

dose.text: Slimpro content in the food supplement (per 25 g, one dose) was 1.4 g.
In the case of two-dose treatment arm, one sachet of the active product was taken 30 min before lunch and one sachet 30 min before dinner.

route.text: Slimpro content in the food supplement (per 25 g, one dose) was 1.4 g.
In the case of two-dose treatment arm, one sachet of the active product was taken 30 min before lunch and one sachet 30 min before dinner.

endpoint.text: Endpoints Primary efficacy endpoints were body weight, fat mass, and safety of use.

reported_results.text: Fat mass was decreased both for the 1.4 g and 2.8 g FPH doses.
Weight was decreased both for the 1.4 and 2.8 g FPH doses.
Hip circumference was decreased both for the 1.4 and 2.8 g FPH doses.
The circumference of thighs was decreased both for the 1.4 and 2.8 g FPH doses.
Waist circumference was decreased both for the 1.4 and 2.8 g FPH doses.
Extracellular water was decreased both for the 1.4 and 2.8 g FPH doses after 90 days of treatment.
